starting-off-talking-to-maisa.player: I know you! You're Maisa, that spy from Al Kharid. But you're meant to be in Menaphos!

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa.text: I told Osman I was done with that posting, and I meant it.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.player: But how did you get out of the city?

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa.text: The same way I helped those citizens of yours. Even with the quarantine, Menaphos are still sending their dead to Sophanem.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.player: So you hid yourself among them? I see. Why are you out here though? And why did you send me that message?

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa.text: Because there's something very strange going on. I intend to work out what, but I need your help.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa.text: My list of allies grows shorter every day, but you actually seem to care about what's happening out here. You also seem to know what you're doing.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.player: Brave of you to assume that I ever actually know what I'm doing.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa.text: Well I'm sure you can't be worse than Osman. You might even have the guts to take some action if needed.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.player: Right... so what are these strange happenings?

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa.text: Citizens from Menaphos have been disappearing. Guards as well. They've been leaving the city, despite the quarantine.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.player: They've been bypassing the quarantine? How?

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa.text: No idea, but I have managed to find out where they've been going.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa.text: South of here, to the old necropolis. They're excavating something there, but I don't know what. There's also something strange going on with them.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa.text: I went to this excavation of theirs to have a look around, and the way they're acting is very unusual. It's like nothing I've seen before.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.player: Interesting. I think I need to see this for myself.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa.text: Well let me know when you're ready, and I'll take you down there.

steps.player: Look at them! How long have they been doing this?

steps.player: How weird. Can we get a closer look?

steps.text: Should be able to. When I came to investigate before, I was able to walk right up to them. They didn't even seem to care. It was like they were in some sort of trance.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Maisa

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.player: Sort of. I still don't know why these people are here, but I do know who sent them.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Maisa

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: It's just quite the claim. How do you know it's her?

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.player: She has hypnotic powers. She's the one that put them in this trance! I know it better than most. I was unlucky enough to experience it myself back in Sophanem.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Head Menaphite Guard
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: Urgh...

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: Perhaps this one can give us something more to go on.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Head Menaphite Guard
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: What's happening? Help me...

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.player: You were hypnotised, but you're free now. Do you remember anything about what happened to you?

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Head Menaphite Guard
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: It's all so unclear... I can't remember...

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.player: I know what you're going through. Try to think back to before you were hypnotised. What's the last thing you remember?

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Head Menaphite Guard
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: We were told we had an audience with Pharaoh Kemesis, but when we arrived at the palace he wasn't there. It was just this woman.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: What woman?

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Head Menaphite Guard
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: I don't know. I just remember her eyes, her deep red eyes...

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: Do you remember anything after that?

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Head Menaphite Guard
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: We came here to find something... I think. A tomb! We unblocked the entrance, and she went inside. There were others with her.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.player: What does she want from the tomb?

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Head Menaphite Guard
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: I don't know... We never saw the inside. The entrance collapsed again after she went in.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.player: That's okay. You've been a great help.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Head Menaphite Guard
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: Wait! I remember one more thing... there were these monsters helping her! They walked like humans, but they had the heads of insects!

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.player: That sounds like those scarab creatures from the tunnels below Sophanem.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: Scabarites! Do you know where they came from?

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Head Menaphite Guard
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: Some ruins... To the north east...

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Maisa
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: I think that's all we're learning from this one. I'll get him some medical attention. Meet me back at my camp.

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Citizen
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: The work must be completed... the mistress commands it...

starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.speaker: Menaphite Guard
starting-off-talking-to-maisa-after-defe.text: The work must be completed... the mistress commands it...

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: So that was... interesting. A hypnotising goddess wasn't quite what I expected.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.player: You sound like you still don't believe me.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: You have to admit, it's a lot to take in. Still, I guess it doesn't change our next steps.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: That guard gave us two leads to look into. Hopefully one of them will give us some answers as to what's so important about that tomb.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.player: Should we reach out to Osman about this?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: Osman? Why? That man won't be of any help. He'd have happily left me to rot in Menaphos, just like how he sent Kaleef to his death!

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.player: Kaleef? He was the spy that was meant to relieve you, right? I thought you didn't even know him?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: What? Oh, right.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: Look, we don't need Osman. We can handle this ourselves.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.player: Fair enough... so what are our leads?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: First up we have Kemesis, Pharaoh of Menaphos.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.player: What do you know about him?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: Truth be told, not a lot. He's probably the most powerful man in the Kharidian Desert, but he's incredibly reclusive. He's rarely seen in public.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.player: If he's under Amascut's control, that could be a big problem. Do you know how we could get to him?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: Even without the quarantine, it would be incredibly difficult. His palace is a fortress.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: It isn't. While there may be ways out of Menaphos, I don't know of any way back in again, let alone a way into the Pharaoh's own palace.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.player: We'll leave that lead for now then. What about the other one?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: The guard mentioned some scabarites. Perhaps we can learn something from them. He said they came from some ruins north east of the necropolis.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.player: That would put the ruins directly east of here. All I see are cliffs.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: Maybe there's something on the other side of them?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.player: Could be worth exploring, I guess.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: Right, so we have our leads. One seems impossible to follow, but the other might have some promise. While I think about how we can access Menaphos, do you want to look into these ruins?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.player: Sure, but where do you even plan to start?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: If we're ever going to get close to the Pharaoh, the Menaphos quarantine has to end. Kemesis himself has made it clear that will only happen when the plagues in Sophanem are eradicated.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: From what I hear, they've managed to deal with most of them now. That just leaves the pox they're all infected with.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.player: So what, you're going to cure the pox?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: Exactly.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.player: Surely if it were that simple, the High Priest would have done it by now.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: Have you met that man? He can try to present himself as a wise leader all he wants, but it's just a facade. The lizards around here have bigger brains than him, and that's probably still an insult to the lizards.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: He didn't even have the guts to get rid of the plagued animals. The guards had to put them down themselves. And it's not like they can do that to the citizens!

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.player: Well, they could. But I imagine that would be considered quite rude.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: Anyway, I reckon I might have a chance of succeeding where the High Priest failed. I have an old friend in Nardah named Zahur. She's a herbalist. I think she might be able to help.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.speaker: Maisa
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-maisa.text: While I go and visit her, you see if you can find these ruins. Remember, they should be just east of here. Meet me in Nardah once you have something.
Maisa leaves the camp.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.text: The spirit looks at you for a moment, before you suddenly hear a voice echoing in your head.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.speaker: Spirit
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.text: Curious... It has been a long time since I've spoken to another. The last time was when my body still had form. Tell me, stranger, what brings you to my tomb?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.player: I was looking for some scabarites.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.speaker: Spirit
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.text: Ah, yes. The fallen remnants of my once great sect. You will find plenty of them here. Why do you seek them?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.player: Do you know of Amascut, the Devourer?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.speaker: Spirit
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.text: All too well.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.player: There's an old tomb south of here. Amascut has been excavating the entrance, and the scabarites have been helping her. She's looking for something inside, but I don't know what.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.speaker: Mehhar
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.text: I see. If you are an enemy of the Devourer and her corrupt scabarites, then you are a friend to me. I am Mehhar, and I can help you.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.player: You can help? Do you know of this tomb?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.speaker: Mehhar
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.text: Even when I still lived, the desert hid many secrets. Now, centuries later, it hides even more. Of all those secrets, few are greater than the ones hidden in that tomb.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.speaker: Mehhar
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.text: It is the resting place of my father, Osmumten. He was once Pharaoh of these lands. My destiny was to succeed him, but the usurpers saw an end to that.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.player: And what are the secrets in his tomb?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.speaker: Mehhar
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.text: Being a Pharaoh offers many luxuries, both in life and in death. Many strive only for these luxuries. They forget that being a Pharaoh also comes with responsibility.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.speaker: Mehhar
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.text: My father had a responsibility greater than most. At the time of his rule, our people were locked in a great war. To hold back the Ruinous Powers, our gods granted us immensely powerful weapons.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.speaker: Mehhar
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.text: When the war was over, my father was tasked with hiding those weapons, lest they fall into nefarious hands. Two of them were buried with him. They will be what the Devourer seeks.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.speaker: Mehhar
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.text: I trust you are aware of what the Devourer desires?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.speaker: Mehhar
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.text: Yes. When the war ended and the Devourer rose from the ashes, she did so with only one goal. She will not stop until every soul, living or dead, has been destroyed.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.player: And these weapons can help her?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.speaker: Mehhar
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.text: Many would call the Devourer a god, but they speak only half truths. She is a demi-goddess of limited power, and does not possess the means to devour souls on a mass scale.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.speaker: Mehhar
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.text: The weapons in my father's tomb can be used to drain a being of divine energy and transfer that energy to another. If used correctly, they would grant the Devourer true godhood.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.player: Then I need to get into that tomb and stop her.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.speaker: Mehhar
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.text: Before you leave, I ask that you remember your original purpose here.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.speaker: Mehhar
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.text: Yes. They have made their home here in my tomb, disturbing my rest. From the chamber above, the High Priest of Scabaras commands them.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.speaker: Mehhar
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.text: He believes he does so in the name of Scabaras. He does not realise that he is actually a puppet of the Devourer.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.speaker: Mehhar
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.text: Free him of her control, and the Devourer will be without a powerful resource. It will also allow me to rest once more.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.player: He might also know more about what Amascut is planning. I did free a guard from Amascut's control through combat. I could try that again.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.speaker: Mehhar
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.text: When the Devourer first emerged, Icthlarin himself taught us an incantation to free an individual from her control. I would suggest you use it, rather than risking harm to the High Priest.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.player: Ah, that seems wise. What's this incantation?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.speaker: Mehhar
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.text: 'Majaan, Manand, Almuk.' Be warned, while it will work on those she has hypnotised, it will have no effect on her corrupted akhs. They are sadly beyond saving.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.speaker: Mehhar
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.text: You will find a key to the upper chamber in an urn to the back of this room. Now go, with the blessing of Scabaras.

steps.player: Tell me more about yourself.

steps.speaker: Mehhar
steps.text: In life I was Mehhar, son of Osmumten. To me, my death was mere moments ago. To you on the other hand, I am surely considered ancient.

steps.player: How ancient?

steps.speaker: Mehhar
steps.text: I sense that the gods have long since departed this world, but when I lived, they still walked among us.

steps.player: And your father, Osmumten? You said he was the Pharaoh. What happened?

steps.speaker: Mehhar
steps.text: My father ruled during the great war. While the war was eventually won, many considered the cost too great. My father led us with the support of the gods, yet he was the one people blamed.

steps.player: So they killed him?

steps.speaker: Mehhar
steps.text: Him, and the rest of my family. I would have died as well, were it not for the bravery of my father's servants. They gave their lives, so that I might live.

steps.player: And then you came here?

steps.speaker: Mehhar
steps.text: To Ullek? Yes. I found solace here with a group dedicated to Scabaras. In time, I became their leader, and the Sect of Scabaras was formed.

steps.player: There's not much left of Ullek now, or the sect.

steps.speaker: Mehhar
steps.text: That is no surprise. Such is the fate of all things. Still, while the sect would have eventually decayed, it was the Devourer's corruption that quickened its demise.

steps.player: I'm sorry.

steps.speaker: Mehhar
steps.text: Don't be. You have a chance to free the High Priest of Scabaras. If you do, the sect may yet be reborn.

options.text: What do you know about Amascut?

steps.player: What do you know about Amascut?

steps.speaker: Mehhar
steps.text: The one you call Amascut died long ago. In her place, the Devourer was born.

steps.player: How did it happen?

steps.speaker: Mehhar
steps.text: Only Icthlarin himself knows the true answer to that question.

steps.player: Okay... but you must have some idea?

steps.speaker: Mehhar
steps.text: During the great war, our forces were decimated by the servants of the Ruinous Powers. To turn the tide, Icthlarin and Amascut sought powerful allies to aid us.

steps.speaker: Mehhar
steps.text: They found them far from here, in a place beyond this world. A powerful race of faceless ones. They became Icthlarin's Stern Judges.

steps.player: What's that got to do with Amascut?

steps.speaker: Mehhar
steps.text: Upon her return, Amascut vanished. She played no further part in the war. Only when the fighting was over did she reappear, but it wasn't really her at all.

steps.player: So you think it had something to do with the Stern Judges?

steps.speaker: Mehhar
steps.text: It seems highly likely.

options.text: Tell me more about the war you mentioned.

steps.player: Tell me more about the war you mentioned.

steps.speaker: Mehhar
steps.text: It started during the rule of my grandmother. An ever-expanding empire to the north set their sights on our lands. War soon broke out.

steps.speaker: Mehhar
steps.text: The armies of the Ruinous Powers were far stronger than our own. That was until Icthlarin's Stern Judges joined the fray. Thanks to them, the war was seemingly won.

steps.player: It wasn't really though, was it?

steps.speaker: Mehhar
steps.text: No. Among the Stern Judges, there was a serpent. After my father became Pharaoh, this serpent convinced the others to abandon us.

steps.player: They joined the enemy?

steps.speaker: Mehhar
steps.text: They did. We were powerless against a force of that might. Nothing could stop their advance.

steps.player: So how did the war end?

steps.speaker: Mehhar
steps.text: It was Tumeken himself. He sacrificed himself to annihilate the enemy. The cost was great, but the war was won.

steps.player: So Tumeken died?

steps.speaker: Mehhar
steps.text: That's a matter of perspective. I died long ago, and yet we are still having this conversation.

steps.player: That doesn't really answer my question.

steps.speaker: Mehhar
steps.text: While Tumeken himself may be gone, he lives on through his four avatars. While they walk among us, Tumeken will always be at our side.

steps.player: I'd better get going.

steps.speaker: Mehhar
steps.text: Scabaras be with you.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.speaker: Mehhar

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.player: I need to get into your father's tomb and stop Amascut.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-spirit.speaker: Mehhar

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.speaker: High Priest of Scabaras
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.text: Argh!

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.speaker: High Priest of Scabaras
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.text: What... What happened?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.player: It's alright. You were being controlled by Amascut, but you're free now.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.speaker: High Priest of Scabaras
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.text: I... I don't remember.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.player: I've been in your position. Don't worry, your memories will come back in time. Familiar places and objects can help them come back faster.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.speaker: High Priest of Scabaras
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.text: This room is familiar... as I look around, I feel something stirring...

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.speaker: High Priest of Scabaras
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.text: Yes, I can see it now! There are a few gaps, but it's all coming back to me. Thank you, adventurer.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.speaker: High Priest of Scabaras
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.text: There is much for me to set right. We have made some terrible mistakes.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.player: I know the feeling. What did she have you do?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.speaker: High Priest of Scabaras
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.text: Many things. I have been under her control my whole life. It was the same for my predecessor, and her predecessor as well. We were all slaves to the Devourer, even our lord himself.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.speaker: High Priest of Scabaras
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.text: Yes. She used him as her puppet for centuries, but now she has a new plan for him.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.speaker: High Priest of Scabaras
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.text: I don't know. She took him into some tomb, along with the others.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.player: Osmumten's tomb. Who are these others you speak of?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.speaker: High Priest of Scabaras
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.text: Apmeken, Crondis and Het. The other avatars of Tumeken.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.speaker: High Priest of Scabaras
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.text: She does. We helped her capture them. It took many lifetimes, but she was able to fool them all.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.player: This isn't good. There're weapons in that tomb that can transfer divine power between beings. She must be planning to use them on the lesser deities.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.speaker: High Priest of Scabaras
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.text: The four of them all came from Tumeken himself. Their power is his power. If she claims that power as her own, she will become a true goddess...

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.player: Don't worry, I'll make sure that doesn't happen.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.speaker: High Priest of Scabaras
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.text: How can you hope to withstand her power?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.player: I'll find a way. Do you have any other information that can help me?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.speaker: High Priest of Scabaras
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.text: We were not the only ones to fall to the Devourer. She has control over Pharaoh Kemesis of Menaphos.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.player: We feared as much. Do you know what she wants with him?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.speaker: High Priest of Scabaras
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.text: She needed control over the city, but she kept the reason a secret. She even had us release locusts and frogs into Sophanem so she could have Menaphos locked down.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.player: You caused the plagues? The cows and the pox as well?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.speaker: High Priest of Scabaras
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.text: We did also poison the cows. I know nothing of this pox, though.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.player: Hmm... what will you do now?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.speaker: High Priest of Scabaras
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.text: I fear many of my people are forever lost, but I will save as many as I can. Together, we will reform the Sect of Scabaras, and right the wrongs of the Devourer.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.player: So you'll help me fight her?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.speaker: High Priest of Scabaras
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.text: In our own way. Before the Devourer, we were an isolated people, just as Scabaras taught us to be. We will go back to that way of life.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.speaker: High Priest of Scabaras
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.text: We may go unseen, but we will be there, fighting the forces of the Devourer wherever they appear.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.player: Good to hear. Now, I'd better head over to Nardah. I have a friend there who needs to hear about all of this.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.speaker: High Priest of Scabaras
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.text: Good luck in your fight, adventurer. May Scabaras guide you.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.player: Do you have any other information about Amascut that could help me?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.speaker: High Priest of Scabaras
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.text: We were not the only ones to fall to the Devourer. She has control over Pharaoh Kemesis of Menaphos.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.speaker: High Priest of Scabaras
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.text: What... What happened?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.speaker: High Priest of Scabaras
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-the-high-p.text: Hello, adventurer. Thank you for freeing me from the Devourer. I would be alone now. Scabaras teaches us to remain isolated, and I have much to think about.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-mehhar-aft.speaker: Mehhar
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-mehhar-aft.text: I sense that the Devourer's corruption has been lessened. I trust you were successful?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-mehhar-aft.player: Does this mean you can rest now?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-mehhar-aft.speaker: Mehhar
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-mehhar-aft.text: That was my hope, but while the High Priest is free, many scabarites have been lost to the Devourer. I sense that they will soon descend on my tomb, hoping to reclaim it.

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-mehhar-aft.player: Is there anything I can do to help?

the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-mehhar-aft.speaker: Mehhar
the-ruins-of-ullek-talking-to-mehhar-aft.text: Continue your fight against the Devourer. Only with her defeat, will we finally find freedom.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.text: Ah, there you are. Any luck in those ruins?

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.player: Plenty. I discovered all sorts of things. How about you?

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.speaker: Maisa
cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.text: I filled Zahur in on our discoveries and obtained a blood sample from one of Sophanem's citizens for her. Don't ask me how. She's looked over it, and thinks the pox should be easily curable.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.speaker: Zahur
cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.text: Yes, it's a very interesting one this. Do you know of the cadava bush?

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.player: Yes! One time I used some to help this young couple. I gave one of them a cadava potion to appear dead.
It all went a bit wrong though, and he ended up with her cousin instead...

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.speaker: Zahur
cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.text: Right...
If the player has completed Making Friends with My Arm:

steps.player: Oh, and I used one another time when I was helping My Arm!

steps.speaker: Zahur
steps.text: You were helping your arm? I'm not sure I need to know about your private life...

steps.player: No, not my arm. My Arm! He's a troll! He needed to kill an old man, so we used a potion to fake it.
It all went a bit wrong though... again. That seems to happen quite often for some reason...

steps.speaker: Maisa
steps.text: What on Gielinor are you on about?

steps.speaker: Zahur
steps.text: Maybe we should get back to what I was saying...

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.speaker: Zahur
cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.text: As most people know, cadava berries are quite poisonous. When used in the right quantity, they can put someone into a deep sleep. Use the wrong amount...

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.speaker: Maisa
cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.text: ... and you're not going to be waking up again. Cadava potions are standard issue for Al Kharid spies for that very reason. In fact, they're what I used to get myself and those citizens out of Menaphos.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.speaker: Zahur
cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.text: Well, the thing about cadava berries is that they're not the only part of the bush that's dangerous. If you're not careful, the bark can have quite a nasty effect on the skin.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.player: Like the spots from the pox! Are you saying that's what caused all the trouble? A rogue cadava bush?

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.speaker: Zahur
cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.text: Maybe, but you won't find any of those bushes this far south. It's quite unexpected. I don't think anyone in Sophanem would even recognise cadava bark, let alone figure out it caused the pox.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.speaker: Zahur
cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.text: To be honest, I probably wouldn't have suspected it myself either. I only realised because of the time I spent training with the Apothecary in Varrock.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.speaker: Maisa
cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.text: It sounds like someone could have caused the pox on purpose.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.player: Well that leads on to what I discovered in those ruins. I found the High Priest of Scabaras there, under Amascut's control. Turns out she had him and the scabarites cause the plagues in Sophanem.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.speaker: Maisa
cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.text: They caused the plagues? Why?

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.player: Amascut wanted an excuse to have Menaphos locked down. She's up to something there, but the High Priest of Scabaras didn't know what. However, he did confirm that Pharaoh Kemesis is under her control as well.
The thing is, now that I think about it, the High Priest of Scabaras didn't actually seem to be aware of the pox. I doubt he'd have been able to get hold of cadava bark either.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.speaker: Maisa
cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.text: So there's other forces at play. That's not good. What else did you find out?

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.player: The next bit is worse, I'm afraid. I found out what Amascut is looking for in that tomb. Apparently, there are two weapons in there that could grant her true godhood.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.speaker: Maisa
cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.text: True godhood? You can't be serious!

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.player: I'm afraid so. She's managed to capture all four of the lesser gods. It's likely that her plan is to use the weapons to claim their power.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.speaker: Zahur
cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.text: The lesser gods? It can't be!

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.speaker: Maisa
cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.text: Are you really sure about all of this?

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.speaker: Zahur
cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.text: Do not doubt the will of the Devourer, Maisa. She is a force of pure evil.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.speaker: Maisa
cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.text: It wasn't that long ago that I didn't even think she was still around. Now I'm hearing she's trying to become a true goddess! It's a lot to get used to.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.player: I do have one bit of good news. I know an incantation that can free a person from her mind control. We can use it to free the people at the necropolis.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.speaker: Maisa
cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.text: Right, well we'd better get to work then. First, let's finish off this cure. Once that's done, we can free the citizens.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.player: Anything you need me to do?

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.speaker: Zahur
cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.text: Maisa has already obtained most of what I need. All that's left now is some scarab venom and a Lily of the Elid.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.speaker: Maisa
cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.text: Okay, let's split up. I'll get the scarab venom.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.player: And I guess that leaves the Lily of the Elid for me. From the name, I assume they grow near the river?

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.speaker: Zahur
cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.text: That's right. I know of a small island just west of here where you can find some.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.speaker: Maisa
cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur.text: As will I.
Maisa departs.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur-ta.speaker: Maisa
cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur-ta.text: So what did you find in those ruins?

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur-ta.player: I found the High Priest of Scabaras there, under Amascut's control. Turns out she had him and the scabarites cause the plagues in Sophanem.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur-ta.speaker: Zahur
cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-or-zahur-ta.text: Hello again. Do you need anything?

options.text: Where can I get a Lily of the Elid?

steps.player: Where can I get a Lily of the Elid?

steps.speaker: Zahur
steps.text: There's a small island just west of here where you should be able to find some.

steps.player: Okay.

cure-me-pox-crossing-the-river-to-the-is.player: Hello there crocodile. I think I'll call you Roger. You're looking very hungry, Roger.
I think I'd better find something to distract you with before I try getting any closer.

cure-me-pox-returning-to-zahur.speaker: Zahur
cure-me-pox-returning-to-zahur.text: Welcome back. Do you have a Lily of the Elid?
If the player does not have the lily:

steps.speaker: Zahur
steps.text: Well, there's a small island just west of here where you can find some.

steps.player: Okay. I'll be back soon.

cure-me-pox-returning-to-zahur.speaker: Zahur
cure-me-pox-returning-to-zahur.text: I think I have everything I need to make the cure now.

cure-me-pox-returning-to-zahur.player: Can I help with anything else?

cure-me-pox-returning-to-zahur.speaker: Zahur
cure-me-pox-returning-to-zahur.text: Actually, I think you can. To make the cure, I'll need to get the ingredients to just the right temperature. While I get them prepared, could you get my equipment heated up?

cure-me-pox-returning-to-zahur.speaker: Zahur
cure-me-pox-returning-to-zahur.text: Just adjust the individual heats until the overall temperature is at the marked level. Be warned, the equipment can be a bit temperamental sometimes.

cure-me-pox-returning-to-zahur-talking-t.speaker: Zahur
cure-me-pox-returning-to-zahur-talking-t.text: I think I have everything I need to make the cure now.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-after-zahur.speaker: Maisa
cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-after-zahur.text: Hey. You should help Zahur with her equipment.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-after-zahur.speaker: Zahur
cure-me-pox-talking-to-maisa-after-zahur.text: Hello again. Do you need anything?

options.text: What do I need to do to this equipment?

steps.player: What do I need to do to this equipment?

steps.speaker: Zahur
steps.text: Just adjust the individual heats until the overall temperature is at the marked level. Be warned, the equipment can be a bit temperamental sometimes.

steps.player: Okay.

cure-me-pox-warming-up-the-equipment.speaker: Zahur
cure-me-pox-warming-up-the-equipment.text: Excellent! I think I have it!

cure-me-pox-warming-up-the-equipment.speaker: Zahur
cure-me-pox-warming-up-the-equipment.text: Now, it's going to take a few batches of this to cure everyone in Sophanem. I'll get started on those right away. In the meantime, I can give you the first batch to take down there now.

cure-me-pox-warming-up-the-equipment.player: Okay. I can deliver it to the High Priest of Icthlarin.

cure-me-pox-warming-up-the-equipment.speaker: Maisa
cure-me-pox-warming-up-the-equipment.text: Meet me back at the necropolis once you're done.

cure-me-pox-warming-up-the-equipment.speaker: Zahur
cure-me-pox-warming-up-the-equipment.text: Here's the first batch for you to take to the High Priest of Icthlarin. Let him know that I'll be sending down the rest once it's done.

cure-me-pox-warming-up-the-equipment.text: Zahur gives you a crate full of cure vials.

options.text: Do you have that first batch of cure for me?

steps.player: Thanks.

options.text: I lost that crate you gave me.

steps.player: I lost that crate you gave me.

steps.speaker: Zahur

steps.player: I don't really know.

steps.speaker: Zahur
steps.text: Well I have the next batch ready now, so you can take that.

Zahur tries to give you a crate full of cure vials, but you don't have enough room for it.
Zahur gives you a crate full of cure vials.

steps.player: Thanks.

cure-me-pox-warming-up-the-equipment-tal.speaker: Zahur
cure-me-pox-warming-up-the-equipment-tal.text: Hello again. Do you need anything?

options.text: Where do I need to take this crate?

steps.player: Where do I need to take this crate?

steps.speaker: Zahur
steps.text: It needs delivering to the High Priest of Icthlarin in Sophanem. Let him know that I'll be sending down the rest once it's done.

steps.player: Okay.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-the-high-priest-o.player: Hello. How are things going here?

cure-me-pox-talking-to-the-high-priest-o.speaker: High Priest
cure-me-pox-talking-to-the-high-priest-o.text: We're making progress on those plagues. With our citizens back, we had enough people to finally drive out the frogs and locusts that were filling the town up.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-the-high-priest-o.speaker: High Priest
cure-me-pox-talking-to-the-high-priest-o.text: We worried they'd just come back, but perhaps we have managed to appease whichever god sent them.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-the-high-priest-o.speaker: High Priest
cure-me-pox-talking-to-the-high-priest-o.text: The infected cows have been dealt with as well. The only plague left now is this infuriating pox. Still, at least it isn't contagious.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-the-high-priest-o.player: Well, I think I might be able to help with that.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-the-high-priest-o.text: If the player does not have the crate:

steps.speaker: High Priest
steps.text: How?

steps.player: Oh... I was meant to bring you something, but it seems I've forgotten it. I'll be right back.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-the-high-priest-o.player: If all goes well, the potions in there should cure the pox. Sophanem will finally be free of the plagues. This is just the first batch. More will come soon.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-the-high-priest-o.speaker: High Priest
cure-me-pox-talking-to-the-high-priest-o.text: Free of the plagues? How is this possible? We tried everything!

cure-me-pox-talking-to-the-high-priest-o.player: Well I just found a good herbalist. What did you try?

cure-me-pox-talking-to-the-high-priest-o.speaker: High Priest
cure-me-pox-talking-to-the-high-priest-o.text: Er... mostly I prayed to Icthlarin and hoped for the best.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-the-high-priest-o.player: Right... Well I have some things to do down at the necropolis. I'll be back to see how the potions are working once I'm done.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-the-high-priest-o.speaker: High Priest
cure-me-pox-talking-to-the-high-priest-o.text: Thank you, friend. You are once again our saviour!

cure-me-pox-talking-to-the-high-priest-o.speaker: High Priest
cure-me-pox-talking-to-the-high-priest-o.text: Thank you for bringing us that cure. We will hopefully start seeing the effects soon.

cure-me-pox-talking-to-the-high-priest-o.player: I'm sure it won't take long. I'll be back to see for myself once I'm done at the necropolis.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Maisa
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: Hey there. Everything go okay with the High Priest?

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.player: I think so. I guess we'll see for sure soon.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Maisa
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: Well in the meantime, do you think this incantation will work?

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.player: It did when I used it on the High Priest of Scabaras, so we shouldn't have any issues here.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Maisa
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: Let's not waste any more time then.
A cutscene starts. The player and Maisa walk towards the citizens and Menaphite Guards.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Maisa
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: Looks like we have a welcome party.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Guard
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: You have been warned before... leave, now...

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.player: Amascut's hold on you all is at an end. Majaan, Manand, Almuk.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Citizen
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: My... my head...

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Citizen
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: What happened?

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.player: You were all enthralled by the Devourer, but you're free now. Things will be confusing at the moment, but your memories will return in time.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Citizen
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: The Devourer? It can't be!

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.player: I'm afraid so.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Maisa
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: You've all been through a lot, but unfortunately you won't be able to return to Menaphos. The city remains locked down.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Maisa
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: You should seek refuge in Sophanem or one of the other nearby settlements. Hopefully you'll be able to go home soon.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Citizen
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: You saved us!

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Citizen
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: Thank you!
The scene pans to the Jaltevas Pyramid entrance.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Maisa
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: Well... that's quite the blockage.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Maisa
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: Clearing it is going to take work. A lot of work.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.player: And time isn't on our side. Amascut is already in there looking for those weapons.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: Two citizens approach the player and Maisa.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Citizen
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: Excuse me...

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Citizen
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: Sorry to interrupt, but we can help.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Maisa
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: What do you mean?

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Citizen
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: We can mine away the blockage for you.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.player: Are you sure? You've already been out here so long.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Citizen
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: The Devourer made us her slaves. We want to help you stop her.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Maisa
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: Thank you.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Citizen
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: We'll get to work at once.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Maisa
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: It's still going to be a bit longer before the cure starts to work. I guess we should head back to my camp for now.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.player: Alright.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: The scene pans to Maisa's camp.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Maisa
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: Stop!

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.player: What is it?

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Maisa
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: Stay quiet!

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.player: What's going on?

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Maisa
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: I know you're here! Come out!
Osman makes himself visible.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Osman
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: Impressive, Maisa.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Maisa
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: Osman! You've been spying on us!

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Osman
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: That is the job of a spy, Maisa. I remember that, but it seems you do not.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Maisa
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: What's that supposed to mean?

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Osman
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: We had a plan, Maisa. You were ordered to stay in Menaphos. Now your recklessness has cost us dearly.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Maisa
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: Don't lecture me on cost. I know exactly how much this little game of yours has cost.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Osman
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: Yes... Kaleef. Did you think I wasn't aware of your little romance?

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Maisa
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: What?

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Osman
fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.text: Did you take me for a fool? I've been dealing in deception since before you were born. Yours was not hard to spot.

fight-with-the-menaphite-akh-talking-to-.speaker: Osman
